sections.heading: How to Use Berries During a Run
sections.intro: Berries are the confirmed in-run power-up resource in Fruit Zombie Survival.
paragraphs: Farm Berries while waves are manageable, then spend them to power up before the lobby becomes unstable. Holding Berries too long can leave you underleveled for a boss spike. Spending too wildly with no plan can also waste tempo if you ignore positioning.

Berries are not Diamonds. Berries support the current run. Diamonds appear in code rewards and broader account progression conversations. Keeping that distinction clear is one of the most important Fruit Zombie Survival tips for new accounts.
If you are learning How to Play Fruit Zombie Survival with friends, assign one player to call Berry timing so the whole team powers up before hard spikes rather than mid-wipe.

faq.answer: No. Berries are in-run power-ups. Fruit Zombie Survival Diamonds are the longer-term currency tracked by badges like Richer than rich.

faq.question: What should I spend Diamonds on?
faq.answer: Missing fruits that advance Collect badges and your current wave or boss plan. Avoid duplicates until collection goals are healthy.
